quote.translation: Hartmann holds that the freedom of necessity is necessity gushing forth freely, and so arrives at the paradoxical concept of "free necessity" (freie Notwendigkeit) (see N. Hartmann, Logische und ontologische Wirklichkeit, Kantstudien XX, S. 23-24; N. Hartmann, Ethik, 1926, S. 587-589).

regions.text: KantstutienXx,S23_24;N.Flartmnn,Ethik,1926,S587-332冬照）、ハルトマンのいふ「自由なる必然性とは目々必然性としての積極自由である。

quote.translation: The "free necessity" of which Hartmann speaks is positive freedom as teleological necessity, whilst causal contingency, as indeterminate spontaneity, constitutes the concept of negative freedom.

regions.text: 因果的偶然性は非決定自發性として滑極自由の概念を構成する。なほ東洋の思想にあつては自由と自然とは乖離對立をしないで融合相卽して見られる傾向が著しい。

quote.translation: In Eastern thought, further, there is a marked tendency to see freedom and nature as fused into one, without setting them in disjoined opposition.

regions.text: 「みづから」の有つ目的々必然性と「じねんに」の有つ因果約必然性とが「おのづからなる自發性に止揚された段階と見ることが出來るかも知れぬ。

quote.translation: It may be possible to regard this as a stage in which the teleological necessity of mizukara and the causal necessity of jinen ni are sublated in the spontaneity of onozukara.

regions.text: と見ることが出來るかも知れぬ。その踏に興味ある問題が含

quote.translation: An interesting problem lies here, but this is not the place to discuss it.

regions.text: その踏に興味ある問題が含まれてゐるが今はそれを論する場合ではない。

quote.translation: On this point, Mr Abe Yoshishige's article "On Nature", published in Risō no. 17, is rich in suggestion.

regions.text: この點に開して「理想第十七號所蔵の安倍能成氏の論文自然に焼て」は示喚に富むものである。以上、非決定的自發性としての因果約偶然が、一方に積極約意味に於ける自由。

quote.translation: I have now briefly considered the relation of causal contingency, as indeterminate spontaneity, to freedom in the positive sense on the one hand and to nature on the other.

regions.text: 他方に自然に對する開係を簡單に考察したのである。その結果精神哲學の何域にあつて目的々必然性の概念を以て因果的偶然性の概念を置き換へようと、する傾向のあることを否み待ない。

quote.translation: It cannot be denied that, as a result, there is a tendency in the domain of the philosophy of spirit to replace the concept of causal contingency with the concept of teleological necessity.

regions.text: 然しながら目的々必然性は根源に於て因果的偶然性に依存するのでなければその意味をなさない。

quote.translation: Teleological necessity, however, makes no sense unless at its origin it depends on causal contingency.
Causal contingency must be the starting point of teleological necessity.
